name: Spring steel hoop
summary: A frame of flat steel hoops on tapes that holds a skirt out in a wide bell, in place of many layers of horsehair and cotton petticoats.
how: Roll thin steel into springy hoops and cover them with cotton braid.
Hang the hoops in a cone from a waist band on tapes, from small at the top to wide at the hem.
Put a thin petticoat over the cage, and then the dress.

origin.note: The steel cage replaces the layered petticoat and cuts the weight of the skirt.

adoptions.via: Day dress and ball gown skirts of the Second Empire stand out on a cage of steel hoops.
